headlines.title: If I Can Only Own Alphabet or Amazon for The Next 5 Years, I’m Choosing This One
headlines.summary: Both Alphabet and Amazon just posted accelerating cloud growth and are pouring tens of billions into AI infrastructure, but only one of them trades at a bargain multiple while controlling every layer of its own stack.

headlines.title: AEP to invest $4bn in 702MW fuel cell project for Google
headlines.summary: The Bloom Energy fuel cell facility near Cheyenne, Wyoming, US, is expected to be fully operational by the end of 2028.

headlines.title: Google Just Started Paying SpaceX $920 Million a Month. Here's What That's Worth per Share.
headlines.summary: The deal is worth up to $30 billion in sales for SpaceX, but it's not fully guaranteed.

headlines.title: BE Stock Slips Overnight Amid AI Selloff: AEP To Spend $4B On Fuel Cells To Power Google
headlines.summary: On Wednesday, American Electric Power Company announced that it will invest about $4 billion in a power generation project under a 20-year agreement with Google, with Bloom Energy expected to power the new facility.

headlines.title: Satya Nadella’s Call for an AI Killswitch is a Hyperscaler Powerplay to Buy
headlines.summary: Satya Nadella pitched an AI killswitch as a safety measure, but the real beneficiary of that idea may surprise you. Here is why one investor keeps adding to his Microsoft position every quarter.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
